query: I have a 57‑year‑old man admitted with asthma exacerbation. Among male inpatients aged 52–62 with asthma exacerbation, what is the 90th‑percentile 72‑hour lab instability score? For the top decile, report mortality, mean LOS, average critical lab events, and compare to age‑matched males.
final_sql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.9) within GROUP (ORDER BY (value - valueuom) / NULLIF(ref_range_upper - ref_range_lower, 0)) AS instability_score, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN deathtime IS NOT NULL THEN labevent_id END) AS mortality_events, AVG(dischtime - admittime) AS average_length_of_stay, AVG(quantity) AS average_critical_lab_events FROM male_labevents_72h; SELECT percentile_cont(0.9) within GROUP (ORDER BY (value - valueuom) / NULLIF(ref_range_upper - ref_range_lower, 0)) AS instability_score, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN deathtime IS NOT NULL THEN labevent_id END) AS mortality_events, AVG(dischtime - admittime) AS average_length_of_stay, AVG(quantity) AS average_critical_lab_events FROM male_microbiologyevents_72h;
